description: Portfolio-first reduction of accumulated technical and organizational complexity. Use when cloud accounts, S3 buckets, GitHub repositories, Slack channels, agent skills, services, SaaS apps, jobs, permissions, policies, dashboards, documents, or AI-generated artifacts have proliferated. Investigates cognitive load, invisible coordination costs, exceptions, ownership, actual and latent value, and safe reduction alternatives. Produces evidence-based proposals for human decision; never changes live systems.
